newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - BHP steel output falls in Sept.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - BHP steel output falls in Sept.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, Australia's only raw steelmaker, said on Friday that its raw steelmake fell six percent to 688,000 tonnes in September, taking total steelmake for the four months to September to 2.846 million tonnes, down one percent from a year earlier.
However, despatches rose 12 percent to 724,000 tonnes, making 2.74 million tonnes for the four months, up eight percent from a year earlier.
BHP said production at its Newcastle works in New South Wales was affeced by hearth difficulties on No. 3 blast furnace as well as the rundown of the No. 4 furnace for reline.
The company said the reline started on September 25 and was expected to take 70 days.
The company said export despatches from Australia for September were 13 percent above the same month in 1995.
